title: FedProto: Federated Prototype Learning across Heterogeneous Clients
layout_note: Server panel spans the top centre; two local-client panels sit side by side below with an ellipsis between them; the uploaded and downloaded quantities travel along orthogonal dashed and solid lines between them.
grouping: Server and each client are large rounded panels with a pale tint and thin grey outline, titled in serif text below or beside (Central Server, Local Client 1, Local Client m). The server panel holds a green inner box with the aggregation equation and a server icon. Inside each client, a left-to-right chain of yellow rounded variable boxes (x, h, y-hat, y) sits under a second row (C_i and the received global C-bar_i).
shapes_depth: Flat rounded boxes in pale yellow for variables, each labelled only with a math symbol; thick dark-grey arrows between them with the mapping written above and its role in italics below (embedding, decision). Losses are salmon double-headed arrows labelled L_R and L_S. Icons: database cylinder with handwritten digit samples beneath, a label tag with coloured class discs (the classes this client holds), a server rack. Upload is a brown dashed orthogonal line, download a dark-green solid one.
proposed_highlight: What is communicated is a named variable box (C_i up, C-bar_i down) rather than a model, and the server's aggregation is written out as an equation in its own green box; heterogeneity is shown by each client's different digit samples and class discs.
lesson: Make the exchanged object a labelled box inside each client panel and route uploads (dashed) and downloads (solid, other colour) as orthogonal lines to a server panel that states the aggregation rule as an equation.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF first page (Copyright 2022, AAAI).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
